items.title: Weakly associated points of a finite flat pullback

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a finite flat morphism the weakly associated points of a pullback are exactly the points lying over weakly associated points of the original module (statement lines 311-321, tag 05FN). One implication is the flat pullback statement, but the converse needs a genuine local computation: one passes to an affine neighbourhood, uses that a finite flat algebra over a local ring is free of a rank which is at least one because a point lies over the image, concludes by looking at stalks that the image point is weakly associated for the pushforward of the pullback, and then applies the statement on weakly associated points under a finite morphism. The local computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
